---
description: Land and archive a proven OpenSpec change.
argument-hint: <change>
---

Land **$ARGUMENTS** explicitly. Shared rules: `.claude/harness/AGENT.md`.

Land requires Land authority.
Run `claude-foundation advance <change> --through archived`. It creates the
session-bound grant, applies the proven outcome uncommitted, archives, and
owns recovery and cleanup. Without authority, stop at `proven`, which is not
delivery.

Never edit product or agreement files. Execute returned actions, `resume`, and
authorized `automaticRecovery` before asking. Preserve state across Authority,
resource, conflict, external dependency, or repeated no-progress boundaries.

Never run or tell the user to run a `land` subcommand (`advance`, `check`,
`resume`, `recover`, `archive`); they are internal. Explain real blockers in
plain language.

`DONE` requires `archived`. Never store credentials, commit, push, or open a PR
without separate authority (`/deliver` or a direct user instruction).
